gloss: right in half; in two equal pieces

definitions.gloss: right in half; in two equal pieces; clean in two
definitions.explanation: Split or divided into exactly two equal parts. Used literally for physical objects being cut or broken, and figuratively for opinions or groups being evenly divided.

examples.japanese: スイカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}った→割る：02334_waru⟧。
examples.english: I split the watermelon right in half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれた→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Opinions were split right down the middle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{折|お}れて→折れる：01266_oreru⟧しまった。
examples.english: A large tree was snapped clean in two by the typhoon.

notes:
USAGE:
The {真|ま}っ prefix intensifies ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ to emphasize an exact, clean split. Used both literally (cutting, breaking) and figuratively (divided opinions, split votes). Very vivid and expressive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (split right in half)
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧ (snap in two)
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧ (be divided right down the middle)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ (opinions split 50-50)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can function as a noun (「{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧」) or adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (「{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧」).
